profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co. based in New York City, where I work within the International Consumer Banking group on the recently launched Chase UK digital banking platform. My role focuses on designing and developing backend microservices using Java Spring Boot, Kafka, and AWS. In addition to supporting the UK platform, I am actively involved in efforts to expand the product into other European markets, contributing to JPMorgan’s broader growth strategy.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer III - International Consumer Banking
positions.description:
-Builds backend cloud microservices to launch first Chase consumer product in a new European market
-Utilizes a stack of technologies including AWS, Java Spring Boot, Maven, GraphQL, and Kafka
-Configures monitoring and alerting using AWS ElasticSearch, Grafana, and Prometheus
-Integrates CockroachDB and DynamoDB into backend systems to support high reliability data storage
-Leverages Helm and Harness to implement CI/CD for microservices running on Kubernetes
-Automates test cases for 100% of new features using JUnit, Mockito, and Cucumber

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Chase UK
positions.description:
-Built backend cloud microservices for recently launched Chase UK banking venture
-Enhanced profitability by creating promotional offers which raised holdings by over 2 billion GBP
-Deployed microservices to AWS EKS using Helm and a custom Harness pipeline
-Ensured software performance for over 2 million active users with Gatling tests

positions.title: Software Engineer I - Authentication
positions.description:
-Developed cloud microservices which reach 340 TPS for user authentication on Chase.com
-Utilized a stack of technologies including AWS, Cassandra, Kafka, and Splunk
-Maintained legacy Java codebase while integrating new Java Spring Boot microservices into existing code
-Deployed microservices through a custom CI/CD pipeline built on Jenkins
-Added layers of resiliency to applications, including circuit breakers, cluster failover, and health checks
-Automated test cases for 100% of new features using JUnit, Mockito, and Cucumber

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
-Collaborated with an Agile team to formulate and implement a technology solution for a nonprofit
-Designed wireframes, created user journeys, and wrote documentation on Jira and Confluence
-Developed a full-stack application using Django and Angular, and deployed with AWS

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Consulted mid-sized businesses to create customized applications that fit their needs
-Collaborated with a team to program web applications using Angular, .NET C#, HTML and CSS based on mockups laid out in contracts with clients
-Communicated with colleagues to refine the desired functionality of applications
-Works efficiently to deliver projects within projected timespans and revenue goals

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
-Communicated directly with customers and utilized interpersonal skills to alleviate issues
-Behaved professionally and respectfully while handling situations of conflict

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Planned and executed activities for campers
-Acted as a friend and role model

-Visits underfunded schools to read with children and promote children's literacy
-Participates in book drives to gather books to donate during visits

projects.title: Interventional Radiology Website
projects.description:
-Collaborated within a team of 4 developers to design and program a website for the OSU Wexner Medical Center Interventional Radiology department to interactively educate their patients about procedures
-Implemented the back-end using Java Spring Boot, the front-end using React, and the database using MySQL
-Led meetings with business sponsors and gathered requirements
-Dynamically responded to feedback and feature changes

projects.title: Malware Detector
projects.description:
-Collaborated with another student to create a program that detects whether an executable may be malware.
-Created a combination of C and Java code that traced the system calls of any executable and compared it to sequences found in 6 common types of malware.
-Trained the detector using sample malware data to find reasonable similarity thresholds and common sequences.
